rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose word for a curtain, especially a window curtain.
Use this when you want to stress that the curtain is made of cloth rather than another material.

example.english: The cloth drapery is breathable, so it is perfect for summer.
example.traditional: 布簾好透氣，夏天用啱晒。
example.jyutping: bou3 lim4 hou2 tau3 hei3 haa6 tin1 jung6 ngaam1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for decorative cloth hanging in graceful folds rather than an ordinary functional curtain.

example.english: Several pieces of decorative drapery hang on the stage.
example.jyutping: mou5 toi4 soeng6 gwaa3 zyu6 gei2 fuk1 bou3 maan6
